name: Gooning
description: (Tag:martial)(Tag:ranged)(Tag:social)(Tag:weapon)You are skilled at gooning, serving as a low-rank thug for a boss. You shake people down for money, intimidate them for their wallets, and fight with novice-level knives, pistols, and unarmed combat. You can use a Brooklyn accent at will, and could easily land a low-ranking job in any organised crime organisation.
